content:
maria (acct-exec): FYI NordicBank POC starts next Tues. They require enforced SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, strict RBAC, and domain-based access controls. Need a quick checklist of blockers so we can sign SOW.
aj (sales): Thanks. Do they expect Dedicated/Private from day 1? That impacts pricing. Who owns SCIM in their org (IAM or infra)?
maria (acct-exec): They want hosted but SSO enforced is non-negotiable. If hosted can't meet domain isolation, they'll require Dedicated or Private. IAM says Okta primary.
sam (solutions): I'll own the technical POC. Quick asks: Okta SAML metadata URL? Do they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated? Also need which Okta attributes for role mapping (e.g., `groups`, `user.email`, `external_id`).
eva (security): Important: audit log retention must be >= 90d, SCIM over HTTPS + client cert preferred, SAML assertions must be signed and support cert rotation. Also need proof of RBAC enforcement at token level.
aj (sales): On pricing — Dedicated reservation vs Private deployment: for a short POC we can do hosted with enforcement if we can bind domain and SCIM sync. If they require VPC/KMS, that's Private add-on. I'll scope numbers after eng confirms.
sean (eng-platform): Private deployment lead time ~4-6 weeks (on-prem slower). VPC Private ~2-3 weeks depending on legal & infra. Hosted changes (domain allowlist + SCIM enable) might be doable in 3-5 business days if no infra changes.
sam (solutions): For Okta -> SCIM we need PATCH support and group membership sync. Example attribute mapping:
```
SCIM mapping:
- userName -> user.email
- urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:employeeNumber -> external_id
- groups -> appRoles
```
Also ensure Okta sends `groups` in the SAML assertion if you plan SAML->RBAC mapping.
maria (acct-exec): Customer also asked about self-serve role creation and restricting admin to infra team. Is granular RBAC available in Console?
sean (eng-platform): Console supports roles: Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer, plus custom role templates. We can scope a custom role for "SCIM admin" that only manages provisioning. Logs show role changes in audit trail.
eva (security): Need to confirm KMS/HSM integration for Private: key rotation policy, who holds keys, and whether we can support customer-managed keys (CMK) in AWS. Also legal will ask about data residency (EU region requirement).
aj (sales): Action items: (1) sam to get Okta metadata and SCIM requirements; (2) sean to confirm timeline for domain allowlist and Console RBAC; (3) eva to draft security checklist for SOW. I'll prep a POC pricing note.
sam (solutions): If we need a fast unblock: CSV user import for groups works as a short-term SCIM workaround. CSV schema:
```
email,display_name,groups,external_id
alice@example.com,Alice Smith,eng;admin,123
bob@example.com,Bob Li,eng,124
```
Use `;` to separate groups.
deploy-bot: test-deploy/nordicbank-scim-check succeeded :thumbsup: 
maria (acct-exec): Great. ETA on Okta metadata from customer is EOD today. Sam, can you draft the POC checklist we send them?
sam (solutions): Yes. I'll post a pared-down checklist in #sales tomorrow AM. Will include test steps for SAML, SCIM sync, RBAC verify, and audit log verification.
aj (sales): One more blocker: pricing — if they flip Private, we'll need a one-time setup fee + monthly platform fee. I'll include options in the SOW draft.
eva (security): Also ask customer about SCIM rate limits and error handling — we need to know if they expect near-real-time updates.
maria (acct-exec): Thx team. I'll consolidate and send invite for a technical kickoff tomorrow 10am CET. @sam @sean please join. :eyes:
